card.name: Verb endings before 'the' in titles
card.fires_on: The ending or stem of a verb (-ing, -ed, or 'from') that is followed by an object such as 'the region' or 'the Gap'. It is seen in general web prose, often in book or article titles.

modes.label: Title verb endings
modes.description: The -ing ending of a verb that opens a book or article title and is followed by 'the'.
modes.example: Brid<<ging>> the Gap Between Knowledge and Practice* by

modes.label: Past-tense endings
modes.description: The -ed ending of a verb in narrative prose, right before its object.
modes.example: Fue<<led>> by high wheat prices and expanded production of

modes.label: From as opener
modes.description: The word 'from' starting a title or a phrase.
modes.example: Benjamin R. Foster.<< From>> Distant Days, Myths, Tales
